nodes.label: TempestOS never calls Xero from a domain service
nodes.rationale: Domain services stay unaware of Xero; the engine observes committed changes and plans writes from desired state. The one exception is InvoicingService.SendAsync, kept because the invoice request already is a durable, reconciled send state machine.

nodes.label: Xero Outbox (Xero.Outbox collection)
nodes.rationale: Per-document FIFO; a newer entry supersedes a pending one; identical or already-succeeded (same hash, same tenant) entries are not queued again; claims record the tenant so Demo successes never stand in for the live organisation.

nodes.label: Status mapping (quotes, invoices, POs, bills)
nodes.rationale: Xero never changes a TempestOS quote; TempestOS only walks DRAFT→SENT→ACCEPTED|DECLINED; invoices only DRAFT/DELETED; paid is read, never set.

nodes.label: Identity and linking model (XeroLink)
nodes.rationale: One link per (tenant, kind, TempestOS key); no existing record changes persisted shape; pre-v0.24 invoices imported as links; links are tenant-scoped.

nodes.label: Sync engine (X6): plan, drain, backoff
nodes.rationale: One request in flight per tenant; Reauthorise and 429 pause all; Unknown entries reconcile by lookup first; backoff min(30s×2^(n−1), 30 min) ± 20% jitter.

nodes.label: Never double-create
nodes.rationale: Create only when no link exists; fixed Idempotency-Key per create; lookup by natural key before any resend of Unknown/InFlight; number lookup before first create; invoices keep ADR-0151 reconcile-before-retry.

nodes.label: Safety rules enforced in code (D3, D4, D7)
nodes.rationale: A DelegatingHandler below every Xero caller answers a synthetic 400 with X-Tempest-Blocked instead of sending; write models expose only allowed statuses; typed client has no email method.

XeroPurchasingOwnership
nodes.rationale: A Xero PO or bill is TempestOS's only when linked or recovered by identity from a logged create; number lookup never proves ownership; deleted → tombstone; Send again releases it under a new key; CannotTell is never re-sent.
